todos.title: Wire contract freeze — session_turn_items + turnStateOps + T2.0 contract review + schema types
todos.description: §3.2.0 freeze BEFORE any handler, in docs/protocol/unified-bridge-protocol.md: session_turn_items (registered ONLY on backendId=codex-remote, others fail-closed unsupported; idempotent singleflight key=(sessionId,turnId); request {sessionId,turnId}; success-shaped ack {detailLoadState:loaded|failed, syncRev, reasonCode?} — canonical items NEVER in result, projection snapshot/patch is the only content writer; process failures → success-shaped failed ack carrying that commit's syncRev+reasonCode; ONLY request-level errors (unknown backend/session/turn, malformed) → WireError; state machine: loading committed to SoT on acceptance → success commits replace_parts+loaded in ONE Kernel transaction → syncRev=N, ack only after commit; iOS completion = replica appliedRev>=N order-independent; failure commits failed+reasonCode then failed ack; retry failed→loading; session delete/archive/generation change → fence drop or typed stale; singleflight follower waits the SAME terminal commit and returns the SAME terminal syncRev (never intermediate loading ack); orphan loading (bridge crash after loading commit) restored atomically to failed(interrupted)). turnStateOps patch op: ProjectionPatch gains turnStateOps:[{turnId,detailLoadState,reasonCode?,generation}] (symmetric with partOps, never disguised full turn upsert — r6 定案 3); reasonCode invariants: failed requires non-empty; loading/loaded UNCONDITIONALLY clear old reasonCode; notRequested only as decode default of absent field, never a network op; illegal combos fail-closed; iOS apply order frozen execution→upsertTurns→turnStateOps→partOps; changedTurnIDs must union turnStateOps ids; state-only patch → orderChanged=false + target turn in changedTurns; same-turn state+parts → exactly one changedTurnID; old patches without the field ignored (live zero-change). per-turn generation: persisted monotonic per-turn counter bumped by any post-completion mutation, admission token=(backendId,sessionId,turnId,turnGeneration), NOT global baseRev. delivery mode registration per (conn,backend,session) window/full at first window-RPC hit. Resource gate = G0 values; over-limit → failed ack + reason code, no truncation. PLUS T2.0 contract review: verify bridge-v1.md projection_window_v1 (R2/R3/R4/R10, snapshot cut, admission, bridge-owned cursor) permits producer-on-demand Kernel extension + per-connection delivery; if not, revise canonical contract + tests FIRST. Go+Swift types + schema bump v10→v11(+ per-turn generation, detailLoadState, producer checkpoint fields) frozen in the same batch with decode tests.

todos.title: T2.0 upstream pagination ↔ projection_window_v1 wiring
todos.description: go-bridge producer admission extension: on older request beyond committed Kernel with hasOlderUpstream fact (upstream nextCursor non-empty), fetch ONE bounded upstream page via ReadThreadSummary internal cursor → desc→asc reverse + inclusive-cursor dedup + prepend into the SAME Kernel truth (same snapshot fence / continuous syncRev chain) → existing slice logic serves the window; never loop-pull full history per request. per-connection delivery: (conn,backend,session) delivery-mode registry + three rules — requester window connection receives the page ONLY via this window result (syncRev=N); other window connections receive a connection-specific no-op revision patch via the EXISTING projection_patch shape + ordered sink (NOT a second pipe) advancing appliedRev N-1→N without new turns or coverage changes; full-projection connections receive the full mutation. honest hasOlder: false only when Kernel has no older AND upstream EOF; un-hydrated must report true; wire cursor stays kernel-derived, upstream cursor NEVER crosses the bridge or embeds in wire cursor. backend-private producer checkpoint: hasOlderUpstream + internal upstream cursor persisted (schema v11+; NOT ProjectionSourceDescriptor.Cursor int64; no fake path-prefix validation); restart revalidates/continues cursor via target RPC (e.g. persisted boundary turn id vs upstream page-1 result), mismatch → typed recovery; recovery bounded (maxPages/maxBytes/timeout + persisted continuation, over-limit → explicit retryable failure).
